disclaimer: Synthetic rendered scenes only (sim/). These numbers measure the vision pipeline against a model of the board and darts; they are not evidence of real-board accuracy.

settings.dart_tips: uniform by area within r <= 170 mm (all darts stay in the board)
settings.exposure: brightness drawn once per trial (base and dart frames share it); noise is independent per frame

tip_signed_error_toward_foot_mm.note: Projection of (true tip - detected tip) onto the unit vector from the detected tip toward the true camera foot point. Positive = the true tip lies further toward the foot.

time_per_frame_ms.measures: wall-clock Vision.ingest() per frame (decode + warp + detection)
